fields.zh: 设置 DNS 缓存算法或容量，请使用有效的算法名和数值。
fields.en: Sets the DNS cache algorithm or size; use a valid algorithm name and value.

fields.zh: 设置 DNS 缓存算法或容量，请使用有效的算法名和数值。
fields.en: Sets the DNS cache algorithm or size; use a valid algorithm name and value.

fields.zh: 设置 DNS 服务器。system/dhcp 来源会使用连接前的系统 DNS 地址；无可用地址时会过滤或补齐。
fields.en: Sets DNS servers. system/dhcp sources use pre-connection system DNS addresses; unavailable entries are filtered or repaired.

fields.zh: 设置直连或回退解析器；system/dhcp 地址会替换或过滤。fallback 仅按回退条件使用。
fields.en: Sets direct or fallback resolvers; system/dhcp entries are replaced or filtered. Fallback is used according to its conditions.

fields.zh: 控制直连 DNS 是否跟随解析策略。
fields.en: Controls whether direct DNS follows resolver policies.

fields.zh: Clash 连接期间保持 DNS 开启，填写 false 不会关闭。
fields.en: DNS stays enabled while Clash is connected; false does not disable it.

fields.zh: 选择 DNS 增强模式；Fake IP 相关字段在使用对应模式时生效。
fields.en: Selects the DNS enhancement mode; Fake IP settings apply when that mode is used.

fields.zh: 控制哪些目标使用或跳过 Fake IP，需配合 Fake IP 模式。
fields.en: Controls which destinations use or bypass Fake IP; requires Fake IP mode.

fields.zh: 控制哪些目标使用或跳过 Fake IP，需配合 Fake IP 模式。
fields.en: Controls which destinations use or bypass Fake IP; requires Fake IP mode.

fields.zh: 设置有效的 IPv4 Fake IP 网段，也可能用作默认隧道 IPv4 地址来源。
fields.en: Sets a valid IPv4 Fake IP range; it may also supply the default tunnel IPv4 address.

fields.zh: 设置 IPv6 Fake IP 网段，还需启用有效的 IPv6 设置。
fields.en: Sets the IPv6 Fake IP range; effective IPv6 settings must also enable it.

fields.zh: 设置 Fake IP 响应的 TTL，在 Fake IP 模式下使用。
fields.en: Sets the response TTL for Fake IP mode.

fields.zh: 设置直连或回退解析器；system/dhcp 地址会替换或过滤。fallback 仅按回退条件使用。
fields.en: Sets direct or fallback resolvers; system/dhcp entries are replaced or filtered. Fallback is used according to its conditions.

fields.zh: 设置 fallback 的使用条件；GeoIP/GeoSite 条件需要相应规则资源。
fields.en: Sets fallback conditions; GeoIP/GeoSite conditions require their data resources.

fields.zh: 设置 fallback 的使用条件；GeoIP/GeoSite 条件需要相应规则资源。

fields.zh: 控制回退 DNS 查询的调度，与节点健康检查的 lazy 不同。
fields.en: Controls fallback DNS query scheduling; separate from lazy node health checks.

fields.zh: 会受 App 的 IP Stack 设置影响；DNS IPv6 还需全局 IPv6 开启。隧道 IPv6 接管是另一项设置。
fields.en: Affected by the app’s IP Stack settings; DNS IPv6 also requires global IPv6. Tunnel IPv6 capture is a separate setting.

fields.zh: 控制相关 DNS 查询的 IPv6 等待时间，不是 VPN 总连接超时。
fields.en: Controls IPv6 waiting in relevant DNS queries, not the overall VPN connection timeout.

fields.zh: 创建 TCP/UDP DNS 监听。代理 authentication、allow-lan 和控制器 secret 不为它提供统一访问保护。
fields.en: Creates a TCP/UDP DNS listener. Proxy authentication, allow-lan, and controller secret do not provide shared access protection for it.

fields.zh: 不生效，Apple 版本不使用此路由标记。
fields.en: No effect; this routing mark is not used on Apple platforms.

fields.zh: 设置 DNS 服务器。system/dhcp 来源会使用连接前的系统 DNS 地址；无可用地址时会过滤或补齐。
fields.en: Sets DNS servers. system/dhcp sources use pre-connection system DNS addresses; unavailable entries are filtered or repaired.

fields.zh: 按域名选择解析器。策略中的地址也会过滤；若全部不可用，该策略可能返回名称不存在。
fields.en: Selects resolvers by domain. Addresses are also filtered; if none remain, that policy may return name-not-found.

fields.zh: 对支持的 DNS 连接优先使用 HTTP/3。
fields.en: Prefers HTTP/3 for DNS connections that support it.

fields.zh: 设置 DNS 服务器。system/dhcp 来源会使用连接前的系统 DNS 地址；无可用地址时会过滤或补齐。
fields.en: Sets DNS servers. system/dhcp sources use pre-connection system DNS addresses; unavailable entries are filtered or repaired.

fields.zh: 按域名选择解析器。策略中的地址也会过滤；若全部不可用，该策略可能返回名称不存在。
fields.en: Selects resolvers by domain. Addresses are also filtered; if none remain, that policy may return name-not-found.

fields.zh: 让相关 DNS 请求遵循分流规则；解析节点域名的 proxy-server-nameserver 不递归应用此设置。
fields.en: Routes relevant DNS requests by rules; proxy-server-nameserver does not recursively apply this setting.

fields.zh: DNS 查询使用顶层 hosts 中的映射。
fields.en: Uses mappings from top-level hosts for DNS queries.

fields.zh: 使用 Clash 进程可读取的系统 hosts；不代表可以编辑 iOS/tvOS 的系统 hosts。
fields.en: Uses system hosts readable by Clash; does not enable editing system hosts on iOS/tvOS.

fields.zh: 启用 IP4P 地址转换，按需使用。
fields.en: Enables IP4P address conversion when needed.

fields.zh: 旧字段可以读取，但当前不产生指纹效果。
fields.en: The legacy field is accepted but has no fingerprint effect.

fields.zh: 关闭相关 quic-go 功能。改回 false 不会清除当前进程已设置的开关，热重载或断开重连均不保证立即恢复。与 TUN GSO 不同。
fields.en: Disables the relevant quic-go feature. Setting false does not clear a flag already set in the current process; neither hot reload nor reconnect guarantees immediate restoration. Separate from TUN GSO.

fields.zh: 关闭相关 quic-go 功能。改回 false 不会清除当前进程已设置的开关，热重载或断开重连均不保证立即恢复。与 TUN GSO 不同。
fields.en: Disables the relevant quic-go feature. Setting false does not clear a flag already set in the current process; neither hot reload nor reconnect guarantees immediate restoration. Separate from TUN GSO.

fields.zh: Android 专用设置，Apple 版本不使用。
fields.en: Android-specific; not used on Apple platforms.

fields.zh: Android 专用设置，Apple 版本不使用。
fields.en: Android-specific; not used on Apple platforms.

fields.zh: 控制相应连接的保活行为；修改后请用新连接验证。
fields.en: Controls connection keep-alive behavior; verify changes with new connections.

fields.zh: 控制相关 HTTP 资源请求的 ETag 使用。
fields.en: Controls ETag use for relevant HTTP resource requests.

fields.zh: 创建 HTTP/HTTPS 控制器。建议绑定回环地址并设置 secret；部分桌面控制 API 不提供。
fields.en: Creates an HTTP/HTTPS controller. Prefer loopback binding and a secret; some desktop control APIs are unavailable.

fields.zh: 控制浏览器跨域访问，不代替密码认证。
fields.en: Controls browser cross-origin access; does not replace authentication.

fields.zh: 控制浏览器跨域访问，不代替密码认证。

fields.zh: Windows 专用管道设置，Apple 版本不使用。
fields.en: Windows named-pipe setting; not used on Apple platforms.

fields.zh: Linux 路由标记，Apple 版本不使用。
fields.en: Linux routing mark; not used on Apple platforms.

fields.zh: 创建 HTTP/HTTPS 控制器。建议绑定回环地址并设置 secret；部分桌面控制 API 不提供。
fields.en: Creates an HTTP/HTTPS controller. Prefer loopback binding and a secret; some desktop control APIs are unavailable.

fields.zh: 三端都不使用用户填写的 Unix 控制器路径。
fields.en: The user-supplied Unix controller path is not used on any of the three platforms.

fields.zh: 设置控制器上的 DoH 路径；控制器 secret 不保护此路径。
fields.en: Sets a DoH path on the controller; controller secret does not protect this path.

fields.zh: 设置控制面板目录、名称或下载地址。名称需为本地相对路径；静态页面不受 secret 保护，API 另行认证。
fields.en: Sets the dashboard directory, name, or download URL. The name must be a local relative path; static pages are outside secret authentication, while APIs authenticate separately.

fields.zh: 设置控制面板目录、名称或下载地址。名称需为本地相对路径；静态页面不受 secret 保护，API 另行认证。
fields.en: Sets the dashboard directory, name, or download URL. The name must be a local relative path; static pages are outside secret authentication, while APIs authenticate separately.

fields.zh: 设置控制面板目录、名称或下载地址。名称需为本地相对路径；静态页面不受 secret 保护，API 另行认证。
fields.en: Sets the dashboard directory, name, or download URL. The name must be a local relative path; static pages are outside secret authentication, while APIs authenticate separately.

fields.zh: macOS 可按连接查询进程名、路径和 UID；iOS/tvOS 固定关闭。无法保证每条连接都能取得进程信息。
fields.en: macOS can query process name, path, and UID per connection; always off on iOS/tvOS. Some connections may lack process information.

fields.zh: 运行时固定关闭；资源准备由 Clash 管理。
fields.en: Always off at runtime; Clash manages resource preparation.

fields.zh: 自动更新已关闭，填写此间隔不会启用定时更新。
fields.en: Automatic updates are off; this interval does not enable scheduled updates.

fields.zh: iOS/tvOS 使用 memconservative；macOS 保留选择。已有预编译资源时不再加载源数据。
fields.en: iOS/tvOS use memconservative; macOS keeps the selection. Precompiled resources bypass source-data loading.

fields.zh: 选择 GeoIP 数据模式，需要对应资源；不会绕过平台的预编译资源要求。
fields.en: Selects the GeoIP data mode and requires matching resources; does not bypass platform precompilation requirements.

fields.zh: 预编译 GeoSite 使用固定匹配器。iOS/tvOS 使用预编译资源；macOS 回退到源数据时才可能使用此选择。
fields.en: Precompiled GeoSite uses a fixed matcher. iOS/tvOS use precompiled resources; macOS may apply this choice when falling back to source data.

fields.zh: 不会让隧道按此地址自动下载；请通过 Clash 的资源管理准备所需数据。
fields.en: Does not trigger automatic downloads in the tunnel; prepare data through Clash resource management.

fields.zh: 不会让隧道按此地址自动下载；请通过 Clash 的资源管理准备所需数据。

fields.en: No longer sets a global fingerprint; use client-fingerprint on a supported outbound protocol.

fields.zh: 设置相关 HTTP 请求的默认 User-Agent。
fields.en: Sets the default User-Agent for relevant HTTP requests.

fields.zh: 设置静态域名与地址映射。
fields.en: Sets static domain-to-address mappings.

fields.zh: 会受 App 的 IP Stack 设置影响；DNS IPv6 还需全局 IPv6 开启。隧道 IPv6 接管是另一项设置。

fields.zh: 设置日志级别。debug 还会在控制器中开启调试接口；排查后可恢复常用级别。
fields.en: Sets logging level. debug also enables controller debugging endpoints; restore a normal level after troubleshooting.

fields.zh: 选择 rule、global 或 direct 出站模式。
fields.en: Selects rule, global, or direct outbound mode.

fields.zh: 保护控制器的认证 API；为空时不要求密码。不会保护静态 UI、External DoH 或其他独立服务。
fields.en: Protects authenticated controller APIs; an empty value requires no password. Does not protect static UI, External DoH, or independent services.

fields.zh: 控制并发 TCP 拨号；修改后请用新连接验证。
fields.en: Controls concurrent TCP dialing; verify changes with new connections.

fields.zh: 未填写时默认 true；明确填写 false 会保留。
fields.en: Defaults to true when omitted; an explicit false is preserved.

fields.zh: 只有 App 允许局域网共享时，YAML 的 true 才会保留；不统一控制 DNS 或控制器访问。
fields.en: YAML true is kept only when the app permits LAN sharing; this does not control DNS or controller access globally.

fields.zh: 设置相应本地代理入口的用户名和密码，不是 DNS 或控制器的密码。
fields.en: Sets credentials for applicable local proxy listeners, not DNS or controller credentials.

fields.zh: 设置相应本地代理入口的绑定或来源限制，不统一约束其他监听服务。
fields.en: Sets binding or source restrictions for applicable local proxy listeners, not all other services.

fields.zh: 请求在监听连接中使用相应功能；是否实际启用取决于系统和连接协商。
fields.en: Requests the feature for inbound connections; actual use depends on the system and connection negotiation.

fields.zh: 请求在监听连接中使用相应功能；是否实际启用取决于系统和连接协商。

fields.zh: 不采用用户指定的出口接口，Clash 自动管理物理出口。
fields.en: The requested interface is not used; Clash manages the physical outbound interface.

fields.en: Configures custom listeners or forwarding; use protocol-specific binding and authentication. Availability also depends on system constraints.

fields.en: Sets a local proxy port; access depends on binding, sharing permission, and listener authentication.

fields.zh: 设置本地代理监听端口；实际访问范围取决于绑定地址、共享许可和该入口的认证。

fields.en: Sets TUIC server TLS; certificates/keys may be valid content or readable files. These are not outbound-node settings.

fields.zh: 设置 TUIC 服务的相应超时，单位为毫秒；零值使用默认处理。
fields.en: Sets the relevant TUIC server timeout in milliseconds; zero uses default handling.

fields.zh: 设置 TUIC 服务端 TLS；证书/私钥可用有效内容或进程可读的文件，不是出站节点设置。
fields.en: Sets TUIC server TLS; certificates/keys may be valid content or readable files. These are not outbound-node settings.

fields.zh: 设置 TUIC 服务参数；实际数值会受默认值、范围和协商限制。
fields.en: Sets TUIC server parameters; effective values depend on defaults, bounds, and negotiation.

fields.zh: 设置 TUIC 服务参数；实际数值会受默认值、范围和协商限制。
fields.en: Sets TUIC server parameters; effective values depend on defaults, bounds, and negotiation.

fields.zh: 开启 TUIC 服务或设置 UDP 监听地址，需满足系统的端口与权限条件。
fields.en: Enables the TUIC server or sets its UDP address, subject to system port and permission constraints.

fields.zh: 开启 TUIC 服务或设置 UDP 监听地址，需满足系统的端口与权限条件。
fields.en: Enables the TUIC server or sets its UDP address, subject to system port and permission constraints.

fields.zh: 设置 TUIC 服务的相应超时，单位为毫秒；零值使用默认处理。
fields.en: Sets the relevant TUIC server timeout in milliseconds; zero uses default handling.

fields.en: Always false; does not change the device clock.

fields.zh: 控制 Fake IP 映射缓存，未填写默认 true；false 关闭。需要可用持久缓存，tvOS 缓存丢失后不保证恢复原映射。
fields.en: Controls Fake IP cache persistence; defaults to true, false disables it. Requires persistent storage; tvOS cache loss may discard previous mappings.

fields.zh: 控制内核策略选择缓存，默认 true；false 关闭。不是保存配置文件的开关；tvOS 缓存丢失后不保证恢复原选择。
fields.en: Controls core policy-selection persistence; defaults to true, false disables it. Does not save Profiles; tvOS cache loss may discard previous selections.

fields.zh: inline 直接读取；远程资源可由 App 预先准备，也可在启动后由内核加载。预编译规则更新可能在下次激活时生效。
fields.en: Inline content loads directly; remote resources may be prepared by the app or loaded by the core after startup. Precompiled rule updates may take effect at the next activation.

fields.zh: inline 直接读取；远程资源可由 App 预先准备，也可在启动后由内核加载。预编译规则更新可能在下次激活时生效。
fields.en: Inline content loads directly; remote resources may be prepared by the app or loaded by the core after startup. Precompiled rule updates may take effect at the next activation.

fields.zh: 定义出站节点；具体参数请查对应协议。节点中的接口名和路由标记受 Apple 平台处理限制。
fields.en: Defines outbounds; consult each protocol for its parameters. Interface names and routing marks are subject to Apple-platform handling.

fields.zh: 支持 select、url-test、fallback、load-balance。fallback 按顺序选择健康项；检查频率受 lazy 和系统运行状态影响。
fields.en: Supports select, url-test, fallback, and load-balance. Fallback chooses healthy entries in order; checks depend on lazy settings and system runtime conditions.

fields.zh: 按顺序分流。macOS 支持进程/UID；iOS/tvOS 不能可靠按应用匹配，进程通配/正则可能匹配空身份，UID 规则另有移除处理。
fields.en: Routes traffic by rules. macOS supports process/UID matching; iOS/tvOS cannot reliably identify apps, process patterns may match empty identities, and UID rules have separate removal handling.
